review.notes: Built by Claude 2026-10-27 for backend.messaging.backpressure (next concept by weight in the Amazon posting, 0.5), at the easiest level on John's request. For the reviewer: (1) 117 lines, one file, origin 'real' (no trimming or stubs), so it is much shorter than the other examples; that is intended for the junior level. (2) A dropped await is easy to see once you look at that line; the difficulty is knowing that the wait is the backpressure. (3) With the bug, a mapping error can also surface as an unhandled promise rejection (the race promise is no longer awaited); the key gives bonus credit for it. (4) Licence checked by Claude from LICENSE and the file header; needs a human check.
